main_text.p: תליל Ch. Cumulatum, accumulatum, aggestum, elevatum, excelsum, excellens, Psalm. 8.1.10. Plural. קרּיּן תלילין Urbes munitæ, Exo.1.11. Jon.Numer.32.17. in T.Hierof. emph. תלילא Deuter.28.52. in Jon. Foemin. תלילן, Deuter.3.5. in T.Hierosol.

תלם תלמא Ch. Porca agri, Sulcus, Job.39.10. Plur. תלמין תלמין Gen.49.4. in T.Jon. & Hierof. quod an huj9 significationis sit, dubito. Elias scripsit se ignorare quid sit. Cum aff. תלמיהא Porcas ejus, Jobi 31. 38. Hinc nomé proprium ܒܪܬܘܠܡܝ Bartulmai, Bartholomæus, quasi Filius sulcorum, seu Frumentum sulcorum: non autem, Filius Ptolemæi, ut quidam volunt.
תלע Ch. Findere, Diffindere, Levit.1.17. in T.Hier. & Jonath.
תולעתא Ch. Vermis, vermiculus: Syr. ܬܘܠܥܬܐ, Mar. 9.43.45.47. Plur. ܬܘܠܥܐ Vermes, Act.12.23.
* תלעב Pahel Ch. Subsannavit, Illusit, irrisit: Insanivit. Idem quod אתלעב, unde forte per pravam punctationem ortum.
תלש תליש Ch. Avellere, evellere, divellere, disrumpere, exstirpare, eradicare, putare, amputare. Ithpeh אתלש Evelli, eradicari, excindi. תליש Ch. Avulsum, evulsum, divulsum, dilaceratum.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are reproduced as best legible; Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms are uncertain and may be imperfect. The final word תלת stands alone at the lower right.
